question: Does the primacy of perceptual awareness extend beyond ordinary perception to other means of knowing?
premises: The argument extends to comparison and other means of knowing.
In all these cases, what appears is clearly of the form of awareness-perception.
This perceptual form of awareness shines forth everywhere.
inference: All valid means of knowing ultimately manifest as forms of perceptual awareness.
plain_english: Therefore, thus, in comparison and in other means of knowing as well, it is clearly the form of awareness-perception alone that appears everywhere.
